Requisition ID: 1616743

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence?
Working together to make the world a little bit better every day. This is our purpose at EY and as a team we go all in to work towards our bold ambition: to create long-term value and growth – for our clients, our people and society. Your role
As part of our Platform, Solutions and Intelligence Team within a European center of excellence in Stuttgart or Munich you will consult multinational clients in cross-border and complex problems. You will take on a wide variety of tasks:

- Conception and implementation of digital transformation projects with a focus on accounting and reporting processes as well as intercompany accounting within the SAP S/4HANA environment

- Involvement in the development of innovative services and preparation of turnkey solutions for clients
- Responsibilities for project progress and technical leadership of teams

Your skillset

- University degree in economics and several years of relevant experience in consulting and collaboration with substantial, complex clients; ideally with a specialization in intercompany accounting and operational transfer pricing issues
- Deep understanding of functional problems in internal and cross-border processes
- Very good application and implementation capabilities in one or more of the following technologies: SAP S/4HANA, SAP Central Finance, SAP Module FI/CO, SAP PaPM, Blackline produccts, Anaplan; Exceptional communication skills in German and English

Your mindset

- Agile: You believe that a flexible mindset is just as important for success as knowledge and skills.
- Curious: You are ambitious and committed. We are looking for people who recognize opportunities, proactively tackle challenges, and find better solutions by asking targeted questions.
- Collaborative : You value diverse perspectives and enjoy working in a team. We are looking for people to help us shape the future and create a working environment based on trust.

Your benefits
At EY, you will work in high-performing, interdisciplinary teams with innovative technologies. We support you in your various life situations with our flexible and inclusive working environment. Inspiring colleagues as well as training and development opportunities both on and off the job will empower you to grow and develop skills that will equip you for the future. We guarantee a steep learning curve.  <>More about our benefits  .

Apply today!
You can find further information on the application process at EY on our Careers page  .

jobs.occupation: Facilities Manager Europe (f/m/d) (Fachwirt/in - Facility-Management)
jobs.description: FACILITIES MANAGER EUROPE (F/M/D)At Clario, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, we develop regulated technology that helps unlock better evidence and improve patient outcomes worldwide. Clario's primary European facilities are situated in Germany, Hungary, Belgium, Switzerland, and Turkey.*Facility Layout Standards and Compliance: Supporting facility layout standards for electrical systems, HVAC, IT infrastructure (phones, conference systems, displays), materials, access control and more. Collaborating with local contractors/vendors/departments to manage these processes through to completion, ensuring compliance with local and state building codes.*Site Coordination: Managing and coordinating the logistics involved in opening, relocating, or closing a facility, including security systems, access control, furniture, signage, showroom/marketing requirements, telecommunications, and more.*Budgeting and Capital Expenditure: Actively participating in the capital expenditure budgeting process and managing purchasing requests for facility needs. Accurately forecasting and preparing facility-related budgets. Conducting financial and business analysis, including preparing reports on expenditures, savings, and areas for cost optimization.*Compliance and Standards Development: Ensuring all facilities are operated and maintained in compliance with local, state, and national laws, company standards, and procedures. Responsible for developing and refining standards as business needs evolve, including ensuring annual occupational safety and fire inspections where applicable.*Stakeholder and Management Communication: Maintaining a dotted line to the local management teams, participating in and reporting at management meetings. Building strong relationships with key business stakeholders by collecting feedback and delivering reports on business-critical aspects, such as occupancy, site launches, and facility improvements and audits.*External Relations and First Point of Contact: Serving as the First Point of Contact for the landlord, labor inspectorate, municipalities, authorities, and occupational safety departments.*Vendor and Contractor Management: Building and maintaining strong relationships with local building management and managing third-party contractors/vendors responsible for facility maintenance and operations. This includes monitoring tasks completed, overseeing technical acceptance, and approving invoices.*Lease and Contract Management: Managing leases and facility agreements, including understanding legal terms and commercial contract structures. Ensuring contracts are renewed and negotiated in a timely manner.*Sustainability and Energy Efficiency: Supporting sustainability initiatives by tracking, reporting, and working towards reducing emissions and waste across facility operations. Implementing energy-saving initiatives, including tracking energy consumption and suggesting areas for improvement.*Crisis and Emergency Management: Developing and maintaining emergency response plans for the facility, including fire drills, evacuation procedures, and pandemic-related safety measures.*Training and Development: Coordinating safety and facility-related training for employees to ensure everyone is aware of evacuation procedures, safety protocols, and proper usage of shared resources like conference rooms, equipment, and storage areas.*Team Collaboration and Support: Contributing to team success by assisting colleagues in resolving internal issues and supporting shared goals.*Quality and Standards Management: Ensuring adherence to organizational SOPs by regularly reviewing and understanding operational guidelines. Supporting the establishment and enforcement of departmental standards to maintain consistent quality service.*Technical and Industry Development: Enhancing expertise through active participation in company-sponsored training programs and maintaining up-to-date knowledge of industry trends and emerging technologies to drive innovation and informed decision-making.WHAT WE LOOK FOR*Bachelor’s degree in Facility Management or a comparable degree with a technical background, alongside additional business management training or further development.*Five or more years of experience in facilities management or an equivalent role, including proven experience in managing technical building projects.*Fluent language skills in both German and English are required. Additional language skills are beneficial.*Organizational and time management skills to prioritize tasks and meet established schedules, timelines, or deadlines.*Creative problem-solving skills with strong project management abilities.*Proficiency in working with computer software, including the MS Office suite.*Ability to influence others without direct authority.*Strong ability to adapt to changing priorities.*A strong desire to succeed while maintaining a professional and positive attitude.*Flexibility to travel to our European sites as needed, typically averaging two trips per year.At Clario, our purpose is to transform lives by unlocking better evidence. It’s a cause that unites and inspires us. It’s why we come to work—and how we empower our people to make a positive impact every day. Whether you're advancing clinical science, building innovative technology, or supporting our global teams, your work helps bring life-changing therapies to patients faster.AnsprechpartnerSebastian BraunJetzt bewerben [https://clarioclinical.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com/en-US/clarioclinical_careers/details/Facilities-Manager-Europe--f-m-d-_R17628]

jobs.description: The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.We investigate how cancer develops, identify cancer risk factors and search for new cancer prevention strategies. The candidate’s tasks will comprise lab management, cell culture, plasmid preps, support in various molecular biology techniques and training of new laboratory members on specifc tasks when required. Occasional mouse work may be required. Routine animal work is covered by a dedicated technician, with the successful candidate only expected to assist during periods of absence or in exceptional circumstances. While the position involves both administrative and laboratory work, there is some flexibility in the balance between these two areas, depending on the successful candidate’s interests. The candidate will work together with other members of the laboratory and will be trained in the various tasks.Your ProfileThe ideal candidate should:- Be motivated, responsible, and well organised- Have completed vocational training as a biological laboratory technician or hold a comparable qualification- Have experience in cell culture and standard molecular biology techniques- Have basic experience in handling mice, ideally hold a FELASA certificate- Be willing to train technical trainees and early-career scientists in specific laboratory techniques- Have a working knowledge of English and German- Have good communication skills and the ability to document laboratory work accuratelyWHAT MAKES THIS POSITION SPECIAL- Training in a range of laboratory techniques- An interesting and varied role, with the opportunity to contribute actively, alongside the wider research group, to laboratory organisation and the group’s future development- Friendly, collaborative, and international working environment- Workplace in the new KiTZ building and access to the modern, state-of-the-art infrastructure of the DKFZ campus- Opportunities for continuing education, professional development, and career progressionWe Offer- Excellent framework conditions: state-of-the-art equipment and opportunities for international networking at the highest level- 30 days of vacation per year- Flexible working hours- Remuneration according to TV-L incl. occupational pension plan and capital-forming payments- Possibility of part-time work- Family-friendly working environment- Sustainable travel to work: subsidized Germany job ticket- Unleash your full potential: targeted offers for your personal development to further develop your talents- Our Corporate Health Management (0)6221/42-1581​Duration: The position is initially limited to 2 years with the possibility of prolongation.Application Deadline: November 4, 2026Applications by e-mail cannot be accepted.Please also knowledge of German is an advantageExperience supervising students is an advantageWe offer the opportunity to contribute to an internationally visible research topic at the interface of solid-state physics and quantum technologies - in an excellently equipped low-temperature laboratory at the TUM Department of Physics and in close collaboration with an innovative industry partner.TUM offers a working environment with flexible working hours, flat hierarchies, and open communication, as well as a comprehensive, free range of professional and personal development opportunities.Remuneration is based on qualifications according to TV-L. jobs.description: About usAirbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.Job descriptionIn order to support the X-Labs department, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for aInternship in Flight Control Systems (d/f/m)Are you looking for an internship and want to get to know the work of a Systems Engineer (d/f/m)?  Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the X-Labs department, as an intern (d/f/m)!- Location: Taufkirchen/Ottobrunn- Start: as soon as possible- Duration: 6 months- Within the X-Labs organization, we are targeting advanced technological breakthroughs that could be key enablers of the next generation products at Airbus.By exploration of new air vehicle concepts and application of disruptive technology bricks we are driving a step change in air vehicle performance and allowing us to significantly rethink air vehicle design. These advances are opening up the design space and enabling us to look at new concepts and new markets previously impossible to envisage.Your locationOur site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria. Are you into sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options.Your benefits- Attractive salary and work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime).- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.- Traveling overseas or within Germany (team events) is possible after consultation and agreement from the department.- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.- Work with modern/diversified technologies.- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.Your tasks and responsibilitiesWe are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Flight Controls Engineering Intern to join our dynamic flight systems team. In this role, you will gain invaluable hands-on experience designing, testing, and integrating advanced flight control systems for our next-generation aircraft. Mentored by senior engineers, you will have the opportunity to take ownership of impactful projects, applying theoretical aerospace concepts to real-world hardware and software challenges.- Flight Control Law Development & Simulation: Assist in the design, modeling, and refinement of flight control laws to meet performance and handling requirements.- Develop FCC dynamic algorithms: Design and optimize dynamic algorithms for the Flight Control Computer (FCC) to ensure reliable aircraft responsiveness.- Implement control strategies in MATLAB/Simulink: Translate aerodynamic data and control theory into high-fidelity digital models.- Conduct Software-In-The-Loop (SIL) simulations to validate control architecture stability: Run rigorous tests to analyze system performance and safety margins.- Hardware: Lead trade studies to evaluate, select, and integrate core flight control hardware for your specific project scope, ensuring seamless communication between sensors, actuators, and the FCC.Desired skills and qualifications- Enrolled full-time student (d/f/m) within Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.- Language skills: English Fluent, good German skills would be an advantage.- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.- Previous project team experience (e.g., Design Build Fly, Formula SAE, university rocketry/UAV teams).- Familiarity with simulation environments like Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) or Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL).- Exposure to hardware integration, avionics, or basic embedded systems.- Eagerness to learn and ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth.Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!#MYCYMThis job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growthBy submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.
